errors.text_span: Fehlerbalken, die mit einer horizontalen Linie mit einer vertikalen Linie am Ende versehen sind, werden über jedem Balken angezeigt
errors.evidence: The black line represents a fixed reference value (1.5% over 2021), not error bars with horizontal and vertical lines.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates government expenditures as a percentage of GDP.
The description omits the x-axis label "% des BIP" and its unit (percentage of GDP).
The description does not explicitly mention that the black line represents "1,5 % über dem Referenzwert von 2021".
The description fails to mention that Poland has the longest bar overall and that Poland, Estonia, and Latvia have the highest green segments (~3.5%).
The description does not note that Italy, Belgium, Slovenia, Luxembourg, and Spain have green segments below 2% of GDP.
